said: Gus: G’day, Kip! Every new islander does the welcome walk. Snap the jetty, your café, a quokka and, well, me. Send the postcards home to Mum and Dad!
New chapter: Rottnest story · Chapter 1: Welcome to Rottnest. Open Quests to track it.
Captain Ruth: Welcome to Mends Street, love. Best view of the city is from right here on the foreshore. Grab a few snaps before you get busy.
New chapter: South Perth story · Chapter 1: Up the Swan River. Open Quests to track it.

Station master Bev: G’day Kip! I’m Bev, I run the trains. Perth is easy once you know the tricks: ferries hop across the river, and trains run between Perth Station, Fremantle, Victoria Park and the airport. Walk onto the platform, step through an open door, pick where you’re going. Give it a go!
New chapter: Perth transport story · Chapter 1: Ferries and trains. Open Quests to track it.
Skipper Lou: Welcome to Fremantle! I’ve sailed in here a thousand times. Start with the harbour: the B-Shed, the museum and the Round House on the hill.
